summary.text: John McAuliff is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 30, which covers parts of Fauquier and Loudoun counties.
John McAuliff has been a member since January 14, 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, John McAuliff was born in New York, in 1992.
John McAuliff studied at Georgetown (graduate certificate in biotechnology) and the University of Richmond (Leadership Studies, 2014).
John McAuliff's listed occupation is small business owner.

John McAuliff's listed memberships and affiliations include the Virginia Medical Reserve Corps (2020-2023), the Fauquier Historical Society board (2017-2024), Love Old Town Warrenton (board chair, 2021-2023), and the Society of the Cincinnati (2010 to the present).
The House profile lists John McAuliff's committee assignments as Privileges and Elections and Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources.
